text:
The court will most likely admit the records. The defendant's testimony that he kept them in the regular course of business is enough to authenticate them under FRE 901(b)(1) and to qualify them as business records under FRE 803(6). Computer records need no special showing beyond that, so the government's remaining challenges go to weight, not admissibility. The team note doesn't change this, because a declarant being available to testify doesn't take a statement outside the hearsay rule, so the records come in under 803(6) and not on that ground.

CONFIDENCE: 70
